8.32.7. iLock_Geography.predicate_library.relation.Transitive¶

class iLock_Geography.predicate_library.relation.Transitive(predArg, args=(0, 1), argOrder=None)¶

Predicate class that converts the given predicate to its transitive closure in terms of two specified components (of the same base type) in the signature of the predicate.

That is, given the predicate with the true points ‘(…, a, …, b, …)’ and ‘(…, b, …, c, …)’ where a, b, c are of the same type, this predicate will build the true point ‘(…, a, …, c, …)’.

isInDomain(*args) Return True is the objects the tuple args are in the domains of the corresponding geo type in the signature.
isSubDomain(*pattern) Return True if the objects contained in the pattern are in the domains of the signature of the predicate.
